Title: Irregular sign-in notifications added to Azure Active Directory Premium

Body.Content: Azure Active Directory identifies your normal user sign-in patterns. When a sign-in falls outside the norm, it's included in a report and your administrators are notified. Learn more about these notifications (and other reporting and analytics tools in Azure Active Directory and Azure Active Directory Premium) in the Active Directory team blog.
